versos.grego: Λέγω δέ, ἐφ’ ὅσον χρόνον ὁ κληρονόμος νήπιός ἐστιν, οὐδὲν διαφέρει δούλου κύριος πάντων ὤν,

controles.web: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;
controles.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
controles.livre: Digo, porém, que, enquanto o herdeiro é criança, em nada é diferente do servo, ainda que seja senhor de tudo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ ἐπιτρόπους ἐστὶν καὶ οἰκονόμους ἄχρι τῆς προθεσμίας τοῦ πατρός.

controles.web: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
controles.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
controles.livre: Mas está sob tutores e administradores, até o tempo determinado pelo pai.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ἡμεῖς, ὅτε ἦμεν νήπιοι, ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου ἤμεθα δεδουλωμένοι·

controles.web: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
controles.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
controles.livre: Assim também nós, quando éramos crianças, estávamos escravizados debaixo dos princípios elementares do mundo.

versos.grego: ὅτε δὲ ἦλθεν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ χρόνου, ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, γενόμενον ἐκ γυναικός, γενόμενον ὑπὸ νόμον,

controles.web: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
controles.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
controles.livre: Mas quando o tempo se completou, Deus enviou o seu Filho, nascido de mulher, nascido sob a Lei,

versos.grego: ἵνα τοὺς ὑπὸ νόμον ἐξαγοράσῃ, ἵνα τὴν υἱοθεσίαν ἀπολάβωμεν.

controles.web: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.
controles.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
controles.livre: para redimir os que estavam sob a Lei, a fim de que nós recebêssemos a adoção como filhos.

versos.grego: Ὅτι δέ ἐστε υἱοί, ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς καρδίας ἡμῶν, κρᾶζον Ἀββᾶ ὁ Πατήρ.

controles.web: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
controles.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
controles.livre: E, como sois filhos, Deus enviou aos nossos corações o Espírito do seu Filho, que clama: “Aba, Pai!”

versos.grego: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἶ δοῦλος ἀλλὰ υἱός· εἰ δὲ υἱός, καὶ κληρονόμος διὰ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
controles.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
controles.livre: Portanto, tu já não és mais servo, mas sim filho; e se és filho, também és herdeiro por meio de Deus.

versos.grego: Ἀλλὰ τότε μὲν οὐκ εἰδότες Θεὸν ἐδουλεύσατε τοῖς φύσει μὴ οὖσιν θεοῖς·

controles.web: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
controles.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
controles.livre: Quando, porém, não conhecíeis a Deus, vós servíeis aos que por natureza não são deuses.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ γνόντες Θεόν, μᾶλλον δὲ γνωσθέντες ὑπὸ Θεοῦ, πῶς ἐπιστρέφετε πάλιν ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ καὶ πτωχὰ στοιχεῖα, οἷς πάλιν ἄνωθεν δουλεῦσαι θέλετε;

controles.web: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
controles.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
controles.livre: Mas agora, que conheceis Deus, mais que isso, por Deus sois conhecidos, por que voltais outra vez aos fracos e miseráveis princípios elementares, aos quais quereis servir de novo?

versos.grego: ἡμέρας παρατηρεῖσθε καὶ μῆνας καὶ καιροὺς καὶ ἐνιαυτούς.

controles.web: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
controles.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
controles.livre: Vós guardais dias, meses, tempos, e anos.

versos.grego: φοβοῦμαι ὑμᾶς μή πως εἰκῇ κεκοπίακα εἰς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
controles.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
controles.livre: Temo a vosso respeito de que talvez eu tenha trabalhado para convosco em vão.

versos.grego: Γίνεσθε ὡς ἐγώ, ὅτι κἀγὼ ὡς ὑμεῖς, ἀδελφοί, δέομαι ὑμῶν. οὐδέν με ἠδικήσατε·

controles.web: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
controles.kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
controles.livre: Rogo-vos, irmãos, que sejais como eu, pois também eu sou como vós. Nenhum mal me fizestes.

versos.grego: οἴδατε δὲ ὅτι δι’ ἀσθένειαν τῆς σαρκὸς εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν τὸ πρότερον,

controles.web: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
controles.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
controles.livre: E vós sabeis que foi com uma enfermidade da carne que vos anunciei o Evangelho pela primeira vez;

versos.grego: καὶ τὸν πειρασμὸν ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου οὐκ ἐξουθενήσατε οὐδὲ ἐξεπτύσατε, ἀλλὰ ὡς ἄγγελον Θεοῦ ἐδέξασθέ με, ὡς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: E não cedestes à tentação de ter desprezo ou repugnância por meu aspecto físico;  ao contrário, vós me recebestes como a um mensageiro de Deus, como ao próprio Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: ποῦ οὖν ὁ μακαρισμὸς ὑμῶν; μαρτυρῶ γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰ δυνατὸν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν ἐξορύξαντες ἐδώκατέ μοι.

controles.web: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
controles.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
controles.livre: Onde está, pois, a vossa alegria? Pois eu vos dou testemunho de que, se fosse possível, teríeis arrancado os vossos próprios olhos para dá-los a mim.

versos.grego: ὥστε ἐχθρὸς ὑμῶν γέγονα ἀληθεύων ὑμῖν;

controles.web: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
controles.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
controles.livre: Tornei-me, por acaso, vosso inimigo por ter vos dito a verdade?

versos.grego: ζηλοῦσιν ὑμᾶς οὐ καλῶς, ἀλλὰ ἐκκλεῖσαι ὑμᾶς θέλουσιν, ἵνα αὐτοὺς ζηλοῦτε.

controles.web: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
controles.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
controles.livre: Eles têm interesse por vós, mas não com boa intenção;  mas querem vos isolar de mim ,para que vós mostreis interesse por eles.

versos.grego: καλὸν δὲ ζηλοῦσθαι ἐν καλῷ πάντοτε, καὶ μὴ μόνον ἐν τῷ παρεῖναί με πρὸς ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
controles.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
controles.livre: É bom, porém, mostrar interesse  para o bem sempre, e não somente quando estou presente convosco.

versos.grego: τέκνα μου, οὓς πάλιν ὠδίνω μέχρις οὗ μορφωθῇ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν·

controles.web: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
controles.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
controles.livre: Meus filhinhos, por quem volto a sofrer dores de parto, até que Cristo seja formado em vós:

versos.grego: ἤθελον δὲ παρεῖναι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἄρτι καὶ ἀλλάξαι τὴν φωνήν μου, ὅτι ἀποροῦμαι ἐν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
controles.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
controles.livre: queria eu estar agora presente convosco, e mudar meu tom de voz, pois estou perplexo a vosso respeito.

versos.grego: Λέγετέ μοι, οἱ ὑπὸ νόμον θέλοντες εἶναι, τὸν νόμον οὐκ ἀκούετε;

controles.web: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
controles.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
controles.livre: Respondei-me vós, que quereis estar sob a Lei: não ouvis a Lei?

versos.grego: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Ἀβραὰμ δύο υἱοὺς ἔσχεν, ἕνα ἐκ τῆς παιδίσκης καὶ ἕνα ἐκ τῆς ἐλευθέρας.

controles.web: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.
controles.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
controles.livre: Pois está escrito que Abraão tinha dois filhos: um da escrava, e outro da livre.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὁ μὲν ἐκ τῆς παιδίσκης κατὰ σάρκα γεγέννηται, ὁ δὲ ἐκ τῆς ἐλευθέρας διὰ τῆς ἐπαγγελίας.

controles.web: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
controles.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
controles.livre: O da escrava nasceu segundo a carne, mas o da livre, pela promessa.

versos.grego: ἅτινά ἐστιν ἀλληγορούμενα· αὗται γάρ εἰσιν δύο διαθῆκαι, μία μὲν ἀπὸ ὄρους Σινᾶ, εἰς δουλείαν γεννῶσα, ἥτις ἐστὶν Ἄγαρ,

controles.web: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
controles.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
controles.livre: Isto serve de ilustração, pois estes são dois pactos: um é o do monte Sinai, que gera filhos para a escravidão, que é Agar.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ Ἄγαρ Σινᾶ ὄρος ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ Ἀραβίᾳ· συνστοιχεῖ δὲ τῇ νῦν Ἱερουσαλήμ, δουλεύει γὰρ μετὰ τῶν τέκνων αὐτῆς.

controles.web: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
controles.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
controles.livre: Ora, esta Agar é o monte Sinai, na Arábia, e corresponde à Jerusalém de agora, pois é escravizada com os filhos dela.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ἄνω Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἐλευθέρα ἐστίν, ἥτις ἐστὶν μήτηρ ἡμῶν·

controles.web: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
controles.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
controles.livre: Mas a Jerusalém de cima é livre; esta é a nossa mãe.

versos.grego: γέγραπται γάρ Εὐφράνθητι, στεῖρα ἡ οὐ τίκτουσα, ῥῆξον καὶ βόησον, ἡ οὐκ ὠδίνουσα· ὅτι πολλὰ τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐρήμου μᾶλλον ἢ τῆς ἐχούσης τὸν ἄνδρα.

controles.web: For it is written,  “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.”
controles.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
controles.livre: Pois está escrito: Alegra-te, ó estéril, que não geras filhos; extravasa gritando de júbilo, tu, que não estás de parto; porque muitos mais são os filhos da solitária, que os da que tem marido.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, κατὰ Ἰσαὰκ ἐπαγγελίας τέκνα ἐστέ.

controles.web: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
controles.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
controles.livre: Vós, porém, irmãos, como Isaque, sois filhos da promessa.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὥσπερ τότε ὁ κατὰ σάρκα γεννηθεὶς ἐδίωκεν τὸν κατὰ Πνεῦμα, οὕτως καὶ νῦν.

controles.web: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
controles.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
controles.livre: Porém, assim como naquele tempo o que nasceu segundo a carne perseguia o que nasceu segundo o Espírito, assim também é agora.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί λέγει ἡ γραφή; Ἔκβαλε τὴν παιδίσκην καὶ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς· οὐ γὰρ μὴ κληρονομήσει ὁ υἱὸς τῆς παιδίσκης μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς ἐλευθέρας.

controles.web: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
controles.kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
controles.livre: Mas o que diz a Escritura? Expulsa a escrava e o filho dela, porque de maneira nenhuma o filho da escrava herdará com o filho da livre.

versos.grego: διό, ἀδελφοί, οὐκ ἐσμὲν παιδίσκης τέκνα ἀλλὰ τῆς ἐλευθέρας.

controles.web: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.
controles.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
controles.livre: Portanto, irmãos, não somos filhos da escrava, mas sim da livre.
